metadata.datasetName: ROOTS Curated Community Travel Knowledge Base
metadata.disclaimer: Demonstration Prototype Data: All entries, costs, and contributor attributions are manually curated sample representations for responsible travel planning. No live availability or commercial booking API is integrated.

approvedDestinations.name: Varkala Cliff & Backwaters
approvedDestinations.tagline: Secluded red laterite cliffs, natural tidal springs, and quiet coir backwaters.

approvedDestinations.name: Nongriat & Cherrapunji
approvedDestinations.tagline: Bio-engineered Ficus living root bridges, sacred forest groves, and cloud plateaus.

approvedDestinations.name: Spiti Valley & Pin Valley
approvedDestinations.tagline: High-altitude desert monastic culture, fossil plateaus, and mudbrick solar hamlets.

approvedDestinations.name: Madikeri & Coorg Highlands
approvedDestinations.tagline: Canopy shaded coffee agroforests, Kodava culinary lineage, and sacred devarakadu groves.

approvedDestinations.name: Ziro Pine Valley
approvedDestinations.tagline: Apatani sustainable bamboo water irrigation, organic millet traditions, and silent pine trails.

approvedDestinations.name: Anegundi & Hampi Beyond Ruins
approvedDestinations.tagline: Ancient granite stone landscapes, hand-woven banana fiber crafts, and river coracle journeys.

approvedDestinations.name: Gokarna Coastal Trails & Honnavar
approvedDestinations.tagline: Unpaved headland ridge hikes, mangrove boat conservation, and secluded coastal coves.

approvedDestinations.name: Wayanad Rainforest & Tribal Foothills
approvedDestinations.tagline: Mist-shrouded bamboo forests, ancient petroglyphs, and organic indigenous pepper orchards.

communityEntries.name: Kappil Secret Estuary Trail & Shell Beach
communityEntries.description: A secluded estuary trail where the Edava-Nadayara lake meets the Arabian Sea. Walk along coconut groves away from tourist beach umbrellas.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Start by 6:45 AM before coastal humidity rises. Carry an eco-friendly water canteen; no single-use plastics permitted.

communityEntries.name: Subhadra Amma's Clay Hearth Seafood & Sadya
communityEntries.description: Homestyle eatery run by a local fishermen family serving pearl spot fish in banana leaf with unpolished red rice and raw mango curd.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Cash only; meal timings strictly 12:30 PM to 2:45 PM until the fresh catch concludes.

communityEntries.name: South Helipad Fishermen Net Hauled Chants
communityEntries.description: Watch and respectfully assist shore-seine fishermen hauling hand-twisted coconut fiber nets with generational rhythm songs.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Maintain polite distance unless invited to lend a hand on the rope line. Ask before taking close-up portraits.

communityEntries.name: Black Beach Natural Freshwater Geothermal Spring
communityEntries.description: Mineral-rich cliffside natural spring stream flowing directly onto black laterite sands, revered by elders for skin vitality.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Gentle mineral water stream; please avoid using chemical soaps to preserve stream purity.

communityEntries.name: Heritage Kathakali & Sopana Sangeetham Courtyard
communityEntries.description: Intimate temple courtyard demonstration explaining eye mudras, natural stone facial pigment preparation, and Sopana singing.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Arrive 30 minutes early to observe the 2-hour natural makeup process before the performance.

communityEntries.name: Ponnumthuruthu Golden Island Silent Canoe Ride
communityEntries.description: Wooden country boat ride through mangrove backwaters to an uninhabited island with a century-old Shiva temple grove.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: No motors used here to protect nesting kingfishers and cormorants.

communityEntries.name: Odayam Beachside Toddy & Neera Tasting Stall
communityEntries.description: Freshly tapped unfermented coconut neera paired with spiced tapioca cakes and roasted dried chili.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Neera is non-alcoholic and best enjoyed fresh before sunset.

communityEntries.name: Anjengo Dutch Fort & Portuguese Coir Village Walk
communityEntries.description: Quiet colonial stone ramparts and shaded coastal alleyways where local women weave coir ropes using ancient spinning wheels.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Small local entry token supporting village women's cooperative.

communityEntries.name: Umshiang Double Decker Living Root Bridge
communityEntries.description: Two-tier living suspension bridge bio-engineered over centuries by Khasi tribes using the aerial roots of Ficus elastica trees.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Requires descending approx. 3,500 stone steps into the river valley. Trek with bamboo walking poles.

communityEntries.name: Kongthong Whistling Village Jingrwai Iawbei
communityEntries.description: Experience the unique matrilineal tradition where mothers compose a distinct musical tune (whistled lullaby) as their child's lifelong name.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Respect village decorum; honorarium directly benefits community preservation school.

communityEntries.name: Mawlynnong Community Hearth: Jadoh & Tungrymbai
communityEntries.description: Traditional Khasi kitchen serving unpolished mountain rice cooked with wild herbs, fermented soybean chutney (tungrymbai), and bamboo shoots.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Organic vegetarian and wild herb options are prepared fresh on earthen woodstoves.

communityEntries.name: Rainbow Falls Secret Natural Plunge Pool
communityEntries.description: A roaring emerald cascade 90 minutes past the root bridges where afternoon sunlight consistently creates vibrant natural rainbows in water mist.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Wear river sandals; currents can be strong near the central pool during monsoon shoulder season.

communityEntries.name: Mawphlang Sacred Grove Herbal Wisdom Walk
communityEntries.description: Guided botanical walk through an ancient virgin forest protected by Khasi religious taboos where nothing, not even a fallen twig, may be removed.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Local guide mandatory. Strictly honor the sacred rule: take nothing and leave only footprints.

communityEntries.name: Arwah Cave Deep Limestone Fossil Chambers
communityEntries.description: Sprawling unlit subterranean cavern with prehistoric marine crustacean fossils embedded in natural limestone ceilings.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Carry a headlamp with good battery life; paths are damp and naturally cool.

communityEntries.name: Dhankar Cliffside Monastery & Sacred Ridge Lake
communityEntries.description: Perched like a swallow's nest on razor-thin eroded clay pinnacles above the Spiti and Pin river confluence. 1,000-year-old Buddhist mud frescoes.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Hike to Dhankar Lake takes 1.5 hours uphill. Walk slow to acclimate to 3,900m altitude.

communityEntries.name: Langza Golden Buddha & Ammonite Fossil Walk
communityEntries.description: High altitude village under the 6,300m Chau Chau Kang Nilda peak. Search for million-year-old Tethys Ocean ammonite fossils in scree slopes.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Do not extract commercial quantities of fossils; preserve the geological reserve.

communityEntries.name: Dolma's Earthen Hearth: Seabuckthorn Tea & Thukpa
communityEntries.description: Solar-heated mud kitchen serving hot hand-pulled buckwheat noodle soup (thukpa), steamed tingmo buns, and wild seabuckthorn berry tea.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Seabuckthorn tea is harvested wild from river banks and rich in natural antioxidants.

communityEntries.name: Kibber Wildlife Sanctuary Snow Leopard Trail
communityEntries.description: Walk the rim of deep gorges with a native village tracker watching for Himalayan ibex, blue sheep, golden eagles, and elusive snow leopards.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: High altitude wind chill; thermal layers and polarized sunglasses essential.

communityEntries.name: Key Monastery Dawn Prayer Chants & Butter Tea
communityEntries.description: Join the young monastic novices at 6:00 AM for early morning Tibetan horns, low bass throat chanting, and sweet herbal butter tea.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Remove shoes at the shrine entrance. Modest attire covering shoulders and knees requested.

communityEntries.name: Tadiandamol Peak Shola Rainforest Ridge Hike
communityEntries.description: Highest peak in Coorg rising through ancient shola grass valleys and stunted cloud forests. Panoramic views towards the Arabian Sea coast.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Permit obtained at base check-post. Leeches common post-monsoon; carry salt or neem spray.

communityEntries.name: Bollachettira Estate: Spice Harvest & Pandi Curry
communityEntries.description: Generational Kodava ancestral plantation kitchen serving authentic pork/mushroom pandi curry braised in tart wild garcinia kachampuli vinegar.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Fresh organic black pepper and vanilla beans available directly from estate drying yard.

communityEntries.name: Chelavara Secret Stream Natural Jacuzzi Pool
communityEntries.description: A secluded cascade upstream from tourist waterfalls with calm natural granite rock tubs shaded by wild fig and cinnamon trees.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Granite rocks are slippery; test depths before wading.

communityEntries.name: Kodava Valaga Drumming & Folk Sword Dance Intro
communityEntries.description: Learn the vigorous martial rhythm of the dudi drum and Bolak-aat folk dance performed during harvesting celebrations.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Interactive session held in an ancestral open courtyard (Ainmane).

communityEntries.name: Apatani Bamboo Stilt Hamlet Walk: Hong & Hari
communityEntries.description: Walk among the UNESCO tentative heritage hamlets of the Apatani tribe known for community-managed forest groves, wooden totems, and intricate facial tattoos of village elders.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Always request polite permission before photographing elderly residents. A local village guide ensures respectful interaction.

communityEntries.name: Tarin Organic Rice & Fish Bio-Agriculture Farm
communityEntries.description: Explore the famous integrated agro-ecosystem where native carp fish thrive in flooded terraced paddy channels without synthetic fertilizers.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Walk along the raised bund pathways; rubber boots provided during sowing/harvesting seasons.

communityEntries.name: Hao Amma's Bamboo Hearth: Pika Pila & Opo Tasting
communityEntries.description: Traditional stilt hearth dinner featuring boiled bamboo shoot curry (pika pila), tapyo herbal salt, and warm organic fermented millet brew (opo).
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Guests sit around the central open fireplace on handwoven cane mats.

communityEntries.name: Kardo High Shiva Lingam & Blue Pine Forest Trail
communityEntries.description: An untrodden ridge path meandering through towering Pinus wallichiana groves to a massive naturally discovered granite monolith.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Calm pine fragrance path; great for quiet meditation and birdwatching.

communityEntries.name: Anegundi North Bank Banana Fibre Artisan Collective
communityEntries.description: Across the Tungabhadra river from the tourist bazaar, visit the women's collective transforming discarded banana plant stems into fine bags and mats.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: All workshop proceeds directly support rural women artisans.

communityEntries.name: Sanapur Lake Granite Coracle Crossing & Cliff Jump
communityEntries.description: Emerald freshwater reservoir surrounded by prehistoric granite boulder pyramids. Safe cliff jump ledges and circular coracle paddle boats.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Life jackets provided by local coracle boatmen. Avoid swimming near irrigation sluice gates.

communityEntries.name: Geetha's Banana Leaf Kitchen: Jolada Rotti & Yennegai
communityEntries.description: North Karnataka village thali with crisp hand-patted jowar rotis, stuffed baby brinjal (yennegai), and roasted peanut powder chutney.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Unlimited traditional servings; refill buttermilk is pressed fresh.

communityEntries.name: Malyavanta Raghunatha Sunset & Continuous Ramayana Chants
communityEntries.description: Lesser-visited hilltop boulder temple where monks have kept an unbroken 24-hour relay chanting of the Ramayana going for decades.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Sit peacefully on the boulder terrace to watch the sunset paint the Tungabhadra valley amber.

communityEntries.name: Half Moon to Paradise Cliff Trail Hike
communityEntries.description: A rugged cliff-edge walking path connecting secluded headlands without motor vehicle access. Secluded coves with emerald green water.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Rocky footing; wear sturdy grip sneakers. Carry hydration packs.

communityEntries.name: Sharavathi River Mangrove Kayak & Estuary Stewardship
communityEntries.description: Silent guided kayak glide through the pristine mangrove delta of Honnavar learning about coastal root preservation from village boatmen.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Kayak and life jacket provided. Early morning or late afternoon tides offer peak bird observation.

communityEntries.name: Annapoorna Heritage Konkani Fish Curry & Sol Kadi
communityEntries.description: Generational coastal family kitchen preparing surmai fry in homemade byadgi chili paste accompanied by soothing kokum sol kadi.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Vegetarian Konkani jackfruit and raw banana curries also freshly available.

communityEntries.name: Edakkal Cave Neolithic Stone Carvings Ridge Trek
communityEntries.description: Hike up Ambukuthi hills to discover cleft caverns with Neolithic petroglyphs carved over 6,000 years ago.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Steep incline with metal stairs; entry restricted to protect petroglyph stone surface.

communityEntries.name: Uravu Indigenous Bamboo Craft & Workshop Experience
communityEntries.description: Spend an afternoon with tribal artisans in Thrikkaipetta village learning to carve traditional bamboo pens, lamps, and musical rainsticks.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: You take home your handcrafted bamboo creation. Direct support for tribal women cooperatives.

communityEntries.name: Kuruvadweep River Island Protected River Crossing
communityEntries.description: Delta cluster of uninhabited islets on the Kabini River, sanctuary for migratory birds, giant orchids, and wild herbal foliage.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Cross via non-motorized bamboo rafts operated by tribal forest staff.

communityEntries.name: Amina Umma's Malabar Bamboo Biryani Hearth
communityEntries.description: Jeerakasala fragrant short-grain rice and hill chicken slow-steamed inside fresh green bamboo stalks over coconut shell coals.
communityEntries.practicalNotes: Served piping hot straight from the split bamboo cylinder.

accommodations.name: Odayam Cliff Village Courtyard
accommodations.description: Traditional terracotta roof homestay with hammock garden, 3 minutes walk to secluded fishing coves.

accommodations.name: The Palm Drift Co-living Dorm
accommodations.description: Eco-friendly bamboo dormitory with communal kitchen and sunset rooftop terrace.

accommodations.name: Nongriat Serene River Bamboo Homestay
accommodations.description: Simple stilt wood and stone rooms perched above clear river waters, managed by Khasi village teachers.

accommodations.name: Cherrapunji Cloud Plateau Eco-Cottage
accommodations.description: Stone masonry cottage overlooking the Seven Sister gorge with fireplace and solar heaters.

accommodations.name: Langza Golden Earthen Solar Homestay
accommodations.description: Traditional thick sundried mudbrick house with south-facing solar sunroom and yak-wool insulation.

accommodations.name: Ainmane Plantation Heritage Courtyard
accommodations.description: 110-year-old carved rosewood ancestral mansion nestled inside private cardamom and pepper groves.

accommodations.name: Hong Stilt Bamboo Village Homestay
accommodations.description: Authentic pine and split-bamboo stilt residence with communal central hearth and valley views.

accommodations.name: Anegundi Courtyard Heritage Guest Rooms
accommodations.description: Restored traditional mud and stone village home managed by local craft guild with open sky courtyard.

accommodations.name: Kudle Hillside Stone Eco-Cottage
accommodations.description: Naturally ventilated red laterite cottage set inside flowering coconut groves overlooking the sea.

accommodations.name: Banasura Foothills Rainforest Treehouse & Cottage
accommodations.description: Sustainable wood and mud cottage surrounded by wild ginger and cardamom plantation streams.
